speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have multiple skin lesions; can you tell me how long you have had them and if they are itchy, painful, or oozing?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential
REQUEST IMAGES: Full body photograph of skin lesions

speaker: Measurement
Doctor
text: The CBC results show a normal white blood cell count, hemoglobin, and platelets, so we can rule out an acute systemic infection for now. Looking at your photos, I notice the lesions are distinct; are they warm to the touch, or do you see any red streaks spreading out from them?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.
